source_row.rationale: A multimodal post-operative pain management approach, combining scheduled non-opioid medications with opioids as needed, helps optimize pain control while potentially reducing overall opioid requirements and associated adverse effects, an increasingly emphasized strategy in post-surgical orthopedic care.
source_row.source_name: AAOS — Multimodal Pain Management After Joint Replacement
source_row.stem: A nurse manages post-operative pain for a client following joint replacement surgery, using a multimodal approach including scheduled non-opioid medications along with opioids as needed. This multimodal approach helps:
